- **New puzzle: "Perfect Disguise"** (Creativity copy color vs. Bliss's own scoring bonus), redesigned shortly after debut so it solves within a single turn instead of spanning several with no on-screen cue.
- Redesigned **"The Lesser Sacrifice"** puzzle so it no longer starts already solved.
- **Power Duel comes to the Discord client** (issue #233 follow-up): invite a friend or a practice bot, save/paste/manage your own decklists via `My Decks`, and submit a deck for either side entirely from Discord.
- The Discord client can now actually **play** a 2-player Duel-format game turn-by-turn (not just create one) -- this includes Power Duel itself, which is playable end-to-end from Discord for the first time once both decks are in.
- Fixed a Discord bug where a player's entire hand could show "needs the web app to play" for no card-specific reason -- caused by 2+ simultaneously active extra-play grants (e.g. two copies of Validation), now handled with its own grant-picker prompt.
- The current puzzle's own goal is now always shown directly in the game display, not just at the start.
